scripts.test: [ -d test ] && TS_NODE_PROJECT=../../tsconfig.test.json TS_NODE_PREFER_TS_EXTS=true nyc mocha --require ../../test/test-setup.ts --recursive --timeout 500 "test/**/*-test.ts" "test/**/*-test.js" || echo "No tests in this package"
scripts.build: test -f ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc || echo '[build] typescript not found outside the monorepo, skipping (assuming already built)'
